news.title: Chip index posts its longest losing streak since 2008 as AI worries deepen
news.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 3.83% on Friday to 11,137.29, its eighth straight loss and 16% below its Oct. 6 level, with all 30 members down; CoreWeave slid 12% as its bond yields topped 15%. NVDA fell 1.43% to $214.13.

news.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops go on sale from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI
news.summary: The Windows laptops offer up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI compute and up to 128GB of unified memory, starting at $2,599. NVDA still fell 1.4% to $214.13 as CoreWeave's debt stress kept pressure on AI-infrastructure stocks.

news.title: Nvidia trims losses as the chip sell-off eases amid AI financing concerns
news.summary: Chip stocks fell for a fifth day on worries about debt-heavy AI balance sheets, even after TSMC posted record Q3 profit; CoreWeave reversed a 7% drop to close up more than 5% after Jensen Huang voiced optimism about the neocloud. NVDA closed down 1.8% at $217.23.

news.title: Nvidia falls 3.2% as a hot inflation report hits AI 'picks and shovels' stocks
news.summary: The S&P 500 (-1.1%) and Nasdaq (-1.9%) had their worst day since July after September CPI raised Fed rate-hike bets. The semiconductor index fell 4.3% (about -12% over a week); NVDA closed at $221.30, roughly 7.5% below its early-October record, while CoreWeave plunged 15.5% on debt worries.

news.title: Nvidia takes minority stakes in French startups Doctolib and Genesis AI
news.summary: Nvidia agreed to buy a minority stake in health-tech company Doctolib (terms undisclosed) and was confirmed as a strategic investor in Genesis AI, small deals that extend its push to build future AI customers beyond data centers. NVDA closed up 1.0% at $228.52.

news.title: Nvidia slips as Microsoft makes its Maia chip its main inference system
news.summary: Satya Nadella called it Microsoft's "biggest bet yet" on its own silicon: Maia will scale to multi-gigawatt deployments from next year and become the primary inference system for Microsoft's services, with a claimed 40% more tokens per megawatt than leading GPU systems. NVDA closed down 1.3% at $226.32; TSMC reports Thursday.

news.title: Nvidia in talks to invest further in Reflection AI or buy it
news.summary: The FT reported Saturday that Nvidia, already an $800M backer, is in early talks to deepen its stake in open-model startup Reflection AI or acquire it, possibly as an acqui-hire; a deal could come in weeks but talks could fall apart. Reuters could not verify the report.

news.title: Nvidia and Micron bounce early after OpenAI projects $70B revenue run-rate
news.summary: OpenAI told investors it expects annualized revenue to reach or exceed $70B by the end of 2026, after Thursday's chip selloff on a ~$50B late-September figure. NVDA opened higher but closed −0.52% at $229.28.

news.title: Two massive trades just happened in Micron and Nvidia
news.summary: Bearish options flow built in semiconductors on Friday: more than 180,000 SMH puts traded by midday vs 50,000 calls, alongside large put trades in Micron and Nvidia.

news.title: NVDA closes at $237.47 (−0.7%); market cap $5.73T
news.summary: Strong Buy consensus from 61 analysts, average target $328.72 (+38%); Q3 FY2027 results expected Nov 18.

news.title: SpaceX in talks to borrow $40B to buy Nvidia AI chips
news.summary: Proposed ~$10B bank loans + ~$30B investment-grade debt led by Apollo; Musk has said SpaceX data centers will use Nvidia hardware exclusively. Talks are preliminary.

listContext.method: Conservative growth at a reasonable price (GARP), rerun on the full US-listed market (StockAnalysis / S&P Global screener, Oct 16, 2026 close). A stock qualifies if it has: market cap of $10B or more and at least a year of trading history; TTM revenue growth of 15% or more that analysts expect to continue (consensus revenue growth of 8%+ next fiscal year and 8%+ a year over the next 3 years); a positive forward P/E of 35 or less and a PEG of 1.5 or less where available; a Buy or Strong Buy consensus from 5+ analysts with 15%+ upside to the average target; beta of 2.6 or less; share count up no
